name: Skyguard
body:
You have trained with the skyguard, elite thaun warriors skilled at aerial combat.

Prerequisite(s): Thaun, base attack bonus +5, Fly 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack rolls made while flying. This bonus also applies to melee damage rolls against creatures on the ground while you are flying.
